WUHAN: A subprovincial city, the provincial capital of Hubei, China.
WUHU: A prefecture-level city in southeastern Anhui, China.
WULFENITE: An orange mineral, lead molybdate, PbMoO₄, found in lead veins.

WUSS: A weak, ineffectual, cowardly, or timid person.
